svg.title: Om Singhal
svg.desc: Om Singhal. Spatial computing, graphics, and the open source tooling underneath. 31 PRs merged at Microsoft, Meta, Apple, and more. Combined B.S./M.S. in CS at Purdue University Fort Wayne. Open to software engineering roles. A black hole with a lensed accretion disk hangs over a perspective grid floor.

g.text: Schwarzschild lensing · disk at 84° · rays traced in NumPy
and the open source tooling underneath
